reason: Preparation only: pin actual merged main source and successful owned production receipt before publishing existing verifier branch

wholeInverse: async function waitForWeek(){mkdirSync(directory,{recursive:true});actualSource();console.log('PASS separate exact native runtime and original inverse controls; no fixture or provider write');}

workflowInverse:
gp-h55-live-qa:
    concurrency:
      group: cloudflare-production-promote
      cancel-in-progress: false
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/verification/gp-direct-h55-live-20261016'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          path: verifier
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: 7fb7252f82fe07e88b134efa8931c2554e5b2677
          path: runtime
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: 'runtime/.nvmrc'
      - name: Validate separate exact accepted main runtime and full original inverses
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        working-directory: runtime
        run: node ../verifier/release/gp-h55-live-qa-20261016.mjs --wait-week
      - name: Install the unchanged production compiler and isolated browser runtime
        shell: bash
        working-directory: runtime
        run: |
          npm ci --ignore-scripts
          npm install --no-save --ignore-scripts --package-lock=false playwright@1.58.2
          node -e "require('node:assert/strict').equal(require('./node_modules/wrangler/package.json').version,'4.112.0')"
          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/gp-workerd-4146" --ignore-scripts --package-lock=false wrangler@4.146.0
          echo "TREATMENT_MINIFLARE=$RUNNER_TEMP/gp-workerd-4146/node_modules/miniflare" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Verify exact W inverse, identity and freshness controls before fixtures
        working-directory: runtime
        run: node --test --test-concurrency=1 ../verifier/tests/gp-h55-live-qa-20261016.test.mjs
      - name: Acquire the original allowed-workflow commissioning identity
        id: gp_oidc
        shell: bash
        working-directory: runtime
        run: |
          raw=$(curl -fsSL -H "Authorization: bearer $ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN" "${ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL}&audience=shift-production-commissioning")
          token=$(printf '%s' "$raw" | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(s).value))")
          echo "::add-mask::$token"
          echo "token=$token" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Verify all original factual W UI, private notes, consent and two-holder isolation on owned main
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: 9e5386dcf455be34c582d93f8bfc79e6
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          SHIFT_COMMISSIONING_OIDC: ${{ steps.gp_oidc.outputs.token }}
        working-directory: runtime
        run: node ../verifier/release/gp-h55-live-qa-20261016.mjs --verify-week
      - name: Preserve exact independently checked-out W runtime
        working-directory: runtime
        run: |
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "7fb7252f82fe07e88b134efa8931c2554e5b2677"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
      - name: Retain original same-serving factual W acceptance evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: gp-h55-member-qa-live-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: runtime/growth-member-live-evidence/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30
